paragraph_replacements.section: ## Establish the claim before checking it
paragraph_replacements.before: Read the connected passage and the conversation around it. Establish who or what the statement concerns, its time and scope, whose knowledge or explanation is being reported, and what the listener would reasonably understand. Resolve references, conversational shorthand and attribution from that context. Read exceptions and qualifications already present in the script with the claim they affect. In `listener_answer`, describe the factual account this episode conveys. Record individual contextual claims and their decisions in `audit.claim_checks`. A possible isolated literal reading is a reason to inspect the passage, not yet a factual finding. Do not broaden a claim to all places or times unless the connected speech actually conveys that scope. A temporal contrast establishes the difference relevant to its passage, rather than an inventory of every observation behind an earlier decision. Require more history only when the contextual account would otherwise be false.
paragraph_replacements.after: Read the connected passage and the conversation around it. Establish who or what the statement concerns, its time and extent, whose knowledge or explanation is reported, and what the listener would reasonably understand. Resolve references, conversational shorthand, attribution and existing qualifications from that context. Do not broaden a claim to all places or times unless the connected speech actually conveys that scope. In `listener_answer`, describe the factual account the episode conveys. Before classifying wording as an added factual assertion, compare the proposed interpretation with a plausible reading grounded in the surrounding account and inspected evidence. Establish which proposition the speech actually asserts. When that context supports an adequate reading, a required finding must explain what factual defect remains or which words still leave a materially misleading alternative plausible. A temporal contrast establishes the difference relevant to its passage; require additional history when the resulting contextual account would otherwise be false. Record the established meaning and its assessment in `audit.claim_checks`.

paragraph_replacements.before: In `audit.claim_checks`, record supported claims as well as contradicted, unsupported and unchecked claims, at the contextual meaning established from the speech. A check may assess several related claim types. The first audit covers the full contextual account, not only suspicious sentences; a recheck maintains that coverage by carrying forward applicable decisions and checking what requires fresh assessment.
paragraph_replacements.after: In `audit.claim_checks`, record supported claims as well as contradicted, unsupported and unchecked claims at their established contextual meaning. A check may assess several related claim types. Record substantive conclusions and factual contrasts as decisions in their own right, including any that close the episode. Anchor each decision to the words expressing that conclusion or contrast. State the conclusion or contrast itself in `contextual_meaning`, its extent and attribution in `context_scope`, and how the inspected evidence establishes its verdict in `rationale`. Preserve its meaning, scope and verdict in `memory_summary`, and link its coverage entry to this decision. Assess supporting premises in their applicable decisions. The first audit covers the full contextual account, including its conclusions; a recheck maintains that coverage by carrying forward applicable decisions and checking what requires fresh assessment.

changes: Exactly two complete paragraphs in each fact instruction; no response schema or other role changes.
qualification: Previous initial Snow controls distinguish the global assertion but do not establish stable interpretation or retained positive decisions. Native candidate outputs and rechecks remain to be assessed by the coordinating chat.
approved_adjustments: Preserve the exact explicit instruction against broadening a claim to all places or times.
Record substantive conclusions and factual contrasts throughout the episode as decisions in their own right.
verification: Exactly two complete paragraphs replaced in each fact instruction; all other paragraphs byte-identical.
Both fact assets resolve to the recorded full after-text for solo and dialogue.
Only fact-review and fact-verification production entries changed; all other production resources match the previous release.
No schema, descriptions, model, role ordering or revision-limit code changed.
baseline_observed_limits: The two independent initial audits distinguish the original contextual ending from the explicit worldwide-priority variant at the finding level. The distorted version receives a supported diagnosis of an unestablished worldwide assertion; no opposite historical chronology is invented.

The acceptable audit requires a repair to the unchanged servant passage after imposing a specific prior belief. The distorted audit has no such finding and records the broader documented account under D10. This does not establish stable interpretation of the disputed connective.

Acceptable coverage 31–33 points only to D14, which assesses drainage and diagnosis at 31–32. Neither its meaning nor memory records the final temporal contrast. Lack of a finding therefore does not establish explicit contextual approval preserved for later review.
These are initial audits, not a native recheck of one audit. They do not demonstrate decision retention, reviewer convergence or stabilization from the audit fields.
rationale: The full frozen instructions already require contextual scope, distinguish genuine ambiguity from an imaginable reading, and justify mandatory status separately. There is no direct conflict to remove. The missing operation is testing a proposed added assertion against a plausible evidence-grounded contextual reading before classifying it as unsupported. The rewritten claim paragraph supplies that operation while retaining mandatory repair for an actual residual defect or material ambiguity.

The audit instructions permit related claim types in one check and require range coverage, but did not explicitly require substantive conclusions or factual contrasts to be assessed in their own right. The schema and validator can accept a range linked to decisions about premises alone. The approved audit paragraph records conclusions and contrasts throughout the episode, including its ending, with meaning, scope, evidence rationale and memory in existing ClaimCheck fields, so subsequent dispositions can address the actual conclusion.
preserved_policies: Source investigation, factual precision, necessary inference, scenic reconstruction, genuine ambiguity, unsupported independent assertions and repair severity remain unchanged.
Retained evidence applicability and bounded repeat investigation remain unchanged; no fresh full audit is required merely because another round begins.
No examples, new response fields, semantic server gates, reader instructions, author tasks, models or revision limits are introduced.
qualification_needed: Read complete candidate audit outputs: the acceptable ending needs an explicit decision assessing its contextual conclusion, not only covered indices or absence of a finding.
The explicit worldwide variant must retain its demonstrated required defect; a narrower reading must not erase words that actually assert global scope.
Read the interpretation and evidence for the unchanged servant connective in both outputs; count justified decisions rather than finding counts alone.
Use a native revision/recheck to inspect retention or justified reassessment of the actual prior conclusion decision and any newly mandatory findings. Independent initial calls cannot establish this.
This is an untested instruction proposal. Any improvement in stability remains to be demonstrated on complete native outputs and independent stories.
proposal_status: The intermediate instruction files from proposal commit 6e7ae6e were removed after their rationale was retained here. The approved complete instructions and before/after comparisons are in this release directory; the proposal remains available in Git history.
